_README: FILL THIS IN. List cards you already know the real PSA 10 price of. Ten to fifteen is plenty. For each one: paste a title the way eBay would write it, and put what you believe the card genuinely sells for in PSA 10. Currency is yours to pick per row. Then run: npm run backtest

_howToFillIn.title: An eBay-style title. Copy a real one if you have it open, otherwise write it the way sellers do: year, brand, set, player, parallel, PSA 10.
_howToFillIn.knownValue: What you believe it actually sells for in PSA 10. Your number, not a guess from a website.
_howToFillIn.note: Optional. Anything you want to remember about why you picked this card.

_theExamplesBelowAreMine: These rows are placeholders so the report runs today. The values are invented, same as the rest of the placeholder data. Delete them and put your own in.
